zh/advisor-welcome.text: 我是林岚。别着急，我们一起照看这座小镇。先去看看市场吧。

en/advisor-welcome.text: I'm Lin Lan. Take your time. We'll look after this town together. Let's start at the market.

zh/advisor-complete-pass.text: 六季走完了，你守住了目标。辛苦啦。要不要回头看看，另一种选择会怎样？

en/advisor-complete-pass.text: Six seasons, and you've met your goals. Well done. Shall we look back and try a different choice?

zh/advisor-complete-retry.text: 六季走完了。有些地方还可以再试试。我们回到最吃紧的那一季，好吗？

en/advisor-complete-retry.text: We've reached the end of six seasons. There's still room to try another approach. Let's revisit the toughest season.

zh/advisor-season-1.text: 先看看正常收成时，镇上的市场怎么运转。之后做决定，心里就有底了。

en/advisor-season-1.text: Let's see how the market works in a normal harvest. That will give us something to compare our choices with.

zh/advisor-season-2.text: 歉收来了，原料紧，成本也高了。选好方案，我们就看看小镇怎么回应。

en/advisor-season-2.text: The poor harvest is here. Materials are scarce, and costs are higher. Choose a plan, and let's see how the town responds.

zh/advisor-season-3.text: 原料开始恢复了，不过供应还紧。慢慢来，看看这季最需要帮哪一头。

en/advisor-season-3.text: Materials are starting to recover, but supplies are still tight. Take a moment to see where help is needed most.

zh/advisor-season-4.text: 原料又宽裕了一些。现在给补贴，效果可能和歉收时不同了。

en/advisor-season-4.text: We've got a little more material now. A subsidy may work differently than it did during the poor harvest.

zh/advisor-season-5.text: 生产条件接近恢复了。有些措施，也许已经可以慢慢收回来了。

en/advisor-season-5.text: Production is almost back to normal. It may be time to ease off some of the support.

zh/advisor-season-6.text: 最后一季，生产条件恢复正常了。照顾眼前，也给下一年留点余地吧。

en/advisor-season-6.text: It's the final season, and production conditions are back to normal. Let's look after today, and leave something for next year.

zh/advisor-result-met.text: 这季的保障目标达到了。我们再看看，为此花了多少现金和储备。

en/advisor-result-met.text: We've met this season's food coverage target. Now let's see what it cost in cash and reserves.

en/advisor-result-unmet.text: We haven't met this season's food coverage target. Let's work out whether people couldn't afford enough, or there wasn't enough to buy.

zh/advisor-first-market.text: 先观察一次没有干预的市场。下一季，限价、补贴和粮仓投放，就由你来定。

en/advisor-first-market.text: Let's first watch the market without intervention. Next season, you'll choose price limits, subsidies, and releases from the granary.

zh/advisor-baseline-done.text: 正常市场已经看过了。进入下一季，就可以选自己的方案了。

en/advisor-baseline-done.text: We've seen the normal market. Move into the next season, and you can choose your own plan.

zh/advisor-policy-settled.text: 这季已经执行完了。想换一种办法，可以免费试算，原来的结果会留着。

en/advisor-policy-settled.text: This season's plan has already been carried out. You can try another approach for free, and keep the original result.

zh/advisor-reserves-invalid.text: 这份草案要用的粮，比粮仓现有的还多。先减少投放，我们再看下一步。

en/advisor-reserves-invalid.text: This draft calls for more grain than we have in reserve. Reduce the release first, and then we'll take another look.

zh/advisor-cash-invalid.text: 这份草案会让国库现金不够。先调整补贴或政策组合，留住周转的余地。

en/advisor-cash-invalid.text: This draft would leave the treasury short of cash. Let's adjust the subsidy or the policy mix, so we can keep going.

zh/advisor-policy-market.text: 你让价格随市场调整。这样能协调供求，但居民能不能买够，还得看看。

en/advisor-policy-market.text: You're letting prices adjust with the market. That can balance supply and demand, but we'll still need to check whether residents can afford enough.

zh/advisor-policy-cap.text: 你准备限制售价。价格压得太低，货可能不够卖，得留意居民实际拿到多少。

en/advisor-policy-cap.text: You're planning a price limit. If it's too low, there may not be enough bread to go round. Watch what residents actually take home.

zh/advisor-policy-subsidy.text: 你准备给工坊补贴。能不能多做面包，还要看原料；国库的支出也别忘了。

en/advisor-policy-subsidy.text: You're planning a subsidy for the workshops. Whether they can bake more depends on materials. Keep an eye on the treasury cost, too.

zh/advisor-policy-release.text: 你准备开仓，增加市场供应。今天用掉的储备，后面就不能再用了。

en/advisor-policy-release.text: You're planning to open the granary and add to market supply. Reserves used today won't be there for a later season.

zh/advisor-policy-cap-subsidy.text: 限价加补贴，可以一起考虑。不过原料仍有上限，货架和国库都得照看。

en/advisor-policy-cap-subsidy.text: You're combining a price limit with a subsidy. Materials still put a ceiling on production, so watch both the shelves and the treasury.

zh/advisor-policy-cap-release.text: 限价配上开仓，能同时影响价格和供应。也要看看，粮仓还给后面留了多少。

en/advisor-policy-cap-release.text: A price limit and a granary release affect both price and supply. Check how much grain you're leaving for the seasons ahead.

zh/advisor-policy-subsidy-release.text: 补贴和开仓一起用，会动到现金和储备。先看看这两份代价，你愿不愿意承担。

en/advisor-policy-subsidy-release.text: Using a subsidy and a granary release draws on both cash and reserves. Take a look at those costs before you decide.

zh/advisor-policy-all.text: 三种措施一起用，影响也会交织在一起。价格、原料、现金和储备，都值得留意。

en/advisor-policy-all.text: With all three measures together, their effects interact. Keep an eye on prices, materials, cash, and reserves.

zh/advisor-pending.text: 这季还没结算呢。方案执行后，我们再看居民带回了多少面包。

en/advisor-pending.text: This season hasn't been settled yet. Once the plan is carried out, we'll see how much bread residents took home.

zh/advisor-shortage.text: 价签降了，可想买的比货架上的还多，只能按比例分粮。便宜，不一定就能多买。

en/advisor-shortage.text: The price is lower, but people want more than the shelves can supply. Bread has to be rationed proportionally. Cheaper doesn't always mean more to take home.

zh/advisor-cleared.text: 这季供需对上了，没有超额需求。不过市场出清，不代表每组居民都买够了口粮。

en/advisor-cleared.text: Supply and demand balance this season, with no excess demand. But a cleared market doesn't mean every group has enough basic food.

zh/advisor-reserves-planned.text: 你打算动用一部分粮仓。先留意眼前的需要，也记得任期结束要留足储备。

en/advisor-reserves-planned.text: You're planning to use part of the granary. Consider today's needs, and remember to leave enough reserves at the end of your term.

zh/advisor-reserves-used.text: 这季已经用掉一部分储备。账本上留下的粮，才是之后还能动用的。

en/advisor-reserves-used.text: We've used some reserves this season. The grain left in the ledger is what we can still use later.

zh/advisor-reserves-saved.text: 这季没有动用粮仓。留下的储备，是后面遇到困难时的一份余地。

en/advisor-reserves-saved.text: We didn't use the granary this season. Those reserves give us some room to respond if things get difficult later.

zh/advisor-reserves-general.text: 粮仓能缓一缓眼前的压力，不过用一篮就少一篮。任期结束，还要留下二十篮。

en/advisor-reserves-general.text: The granary can ease today's pressure, but every basket used is one less for later. We need to finish with twenty baskets in reserve.

zh/advisor-farm.text: 农田给的是原料上限，不是已经做好的面包。补贴再多，也不能让原料凭空增加。

en/advisor-farm.text: The farm sets the material limit. That isn't bread already produced. A larger subsidy can't create extra materials out of thin air.

zh/advisor-production-plan.text: 工坊会看售价和成本来安排生产。能不能多做，还得看原料有没有余地。

en/advisor-production-plan.text: The workshops plan production around prices and costs. Whether they can make more also depends on the materials available.

zh/advisor-production-subsidy.text: 草案里的补贴会提高工坊每篮的收入。可是原料用尽了，就做不出更多面包。

en/advisor-production-subsidy.text: The draft subsidy would raise what workshops receive per basket. But once materials run out, they can't bake any more.

zh/advisor-production-limit.text: 这季私人产量已经碰到原料上限了。想再增加供应，就得看看别的办法。

en/advisor-production-limit.text: Private production has reached the material limit this season. To add more supply, we'll need to consider another approach.

zh/advisor-production-room.text: 这季原料还没用到上限。工坊实际做多少，仍然取决于售价和成本。

en/advisor-production-room.text: Production stayed below the material limit this season. What workshops actually make still depends on prices and costs.

zh/advisor-market-plan.text: 现在没有售价上限。成交价和居民买到的数量，要等开市后再看。

en/advisor-market-plan.text: There's no price limit at the moment. We'll see the trading price and residents' purchases once the market opens.

zh/advisor-market-cap-plan.text: 限价还在草案里。只有低于原本的均衡价格，它才会起作用；先别把草案当结果。

en/advisor-market-cap-plan.text: The price limit is still a draft. It only binds below the market's equilibrium price. Let's not mistake a plan for a result.

zh/advisor-opportunity.text: 开仓能救急，也会减少未来的余地。而且粮仓是按市场价卖粮，不是免费发放。

en/advisor-opportunity.text: Opening the granary can help now, but leaves less for later. And the grain is sold at the market price. It isn't given away.

zh/advisor-lesson-cap.text: 限价压得低，大家想多买，工坊却可能少做。最后要看带回家的面包，别只盯着价签。

en/advisor-lesson-cap.text: A low price limit makes people want more, while workshops may produce less. Watch the bread people take home, not just the price tag.

zh/advisor-lesson-subsidy.text: 补贴能鼓励生产，但增产要有原料。原料用尽了，钱照样花，面包却不会凭空多出来。

en/advisor-lesson-subsidy.text: A subsidy can encourage production, but extra output needs materials. Once those run out, the money still gets spent without creating more bread.

zh/advisor-lesson-release.text: 开仓把储备送进市场，能缓解眼前的供应压力。不过这些粮，下一季就不能再用了。

en/advisor-lesson-release.text: Opening the granary adds reserves to the market and eases supply pressure now. But that grain won't be available next season.

zh/advisor-access-pending.text: 降价会让人想多买，可货架不一定跟着变满。等执行以后，再看看大家实际带回多少。

en/advisor-access-pending.text: Lower prices make people want more, but don't automatically fill the shelves. After the plan runs, let's see what people actually take home.

zh/advisor-access-enough.text: 这季低收入组已经买够基本口粮了。价格和供应，两头都在影响他们的篮子。

en/advisor-access-enough.text: The low-income group bought enough basic food this season. Both prices and supply shape what ends up in their baskets.

zh/advisor-access-low.text: 这季市场虽然出清了，低收入组仍没买够口粮。买得到，也可能买不起足够的量。

en/advisor-access-low.text: The market cleared, but the low-income group still didn't buy enough basic food. Bread can be available without enough of it being affordable.

zh/farm-normal.text: 原料都备着呢。来，看看这些袋子，工坊能做多少，先得看它们。

en/farm-normal.text: The materials are ready. Come, have a look at these sacks. What the workshops can make starts here.

zh/farm-tight.text: 唉，这季原料紧。再怎么赶工，也得先有粮啊。

en/farm-tight.text: Ah, materials are tight this season. However hard we work, we need the grain first.

zh/farm-recovery.text: 比上季宽裕些了。去工坊问问阿诚，看看他怎么安排。

en/farm-recovery.text: We've got a little more than last season. Go and ask Cheng at the workshop what he's planning.

zh/farm-inspect.text: 袋子上的数，记的是原料最多能支持做多少。可不是已经出炉的面包。

en/farm-inspect.text: The figure on the sacks tells you the most our materials can support. It isn't bread that's already come out of the oven.

zh/mill-pending.text: 做多少，得看售价和成本。先别数筐，开工的安排还没定呢。

en/mill-pending.text: How much we make depends on the price and our costs. Don't count the baskets yet. The production plan isn't settled.

zh/mill-subsidy-pending.text: 听说草案里有补贴？我先记着。等方案敲定，再安排开工。

en/mill-subsidy-pending.text: There's a subsidy in the draft? I'll keep that in mind. Once the plan is final, we can arrange production.

zh/mill-at-limit.text: 这季原料已经用到上限了。再添一筐，也得先等原料。

en/mill-at-limit.text: We've hit the material limit this season. Even one more basket needs more supplies first.

zh/mill-below-limit.text: 这季做完了，原料还有余地。到底做多少，还得看卖价和成本合不合适。

en/mill-below-limit.text: This season's production is done, with some material capacity left. How much we make depends on whether the price covers the cost.

zh/mill-inspect.text: 这是我们的生产单。上限归上限，实际做了多少，要看结算后的记录。

en/mill-inspect.text: Here's our production sheet. Capacity is one thing. The amount we actually made is in the settled record.

zh/market-pending.text: 价签先空着，等开市再换。工坊和粮仓能送多少货，还得等等。

en/market-pending.text: I'll leave the price tag blank until the market opens. We're still waiting to see what the workshops and granary send.

zh/market-cap-pending.text: 草案里的最高价，我记下了。不过还没执行呢，价签先不换。

en/market-cap-pending.text: I've noted the draft price limit. It hasn't taken effect yet, so I'll leave the price tag as it is.

zh/market-shortage.text: 想买的比送来的还多，只能分着卖了。价签低，可不等于货就够啊。

en/market-shortage.text: People want more than we've received, so we have to share it out. A low price tag doesn't mean there's enough on the shelves.

zh/market-cleared.text: 这季供需对上了。居民到底带回多少，你去问问周婶吧。

en/market-cleared.text: Supply and demand matched this season. To hear what residents took home, go and ask Auntie Zhou.

zh/market-inspect.text: 翻开账本看看吧。成交价、送来的货、还想买的量，得分开看。

en/market-inspect.text: Have a look through the ledger. The trading price, the supply, and any excess demand are different things.

zh/homes-pending.text: 我们低收入组的口粮需求没变。等开市了，再看看能带回多少吧。

en/homes-pending.text: Our low-income group's basic food needs haven't changed. Once the market opens, we'll see how much we can bring home.

zh/homes-enough.text: 我们这组买够基本口粮了。总算能松一口气。

en/homes-enough.text: Our group bought enough basic food. We can finally breathe a little easier.

zh/homes-low.text: 我们这组带回来的，还是不够基本口粮。得再想想办法呀。

en/homes-low.text: What our group brought home still isn't enough for our basic needs. We'll have to find another way.

zh/homes-inspect.text: 这本账记的是我们整组人的粮，不是我一家。买回多少、够不够，都在这里。

en/homes-inspect.text: This ledger is for our whole group, not just my family. It shows how much we bought, and whether it's enough.

zh/advisor-result-unmet.text: 这季的保障还没达标。别急，我们一起看看，是买不起，还是货不够。

zh/market-inspect-pending.text: 价签还没定呢。草案归草案，成交价和货量，都得等开市再看。

zh/homes-inspect-pending.text: 这是我们整组人的口粮账，不是我一家。买得到多少，还得等开市呢。

en/homes-inspect-pending.text: This food ledger is for our whole group, not just my family. We'll have to wait for the market to open to see how much we can buy.

en/market-inspect-pending.text: The price tag isn't final yet. A draft is just a draft. We'll know the trading price and supply once the market opens.
